value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic symmetric girth-six Levi graph at the first nonvanishing off-diagonal magnitude boundary. An integral primitive torsion-free classification of all endpoint components supplies the missing all-prime information of the previously published F2 census, including 36 distance-four groups. This exact natural invariant is not automatically implied by field-two computations and supports comparison to torsion-bearing graph magnitude examples.
